name: robots/robotis-git__turtlebot3
title: ROBOTIS TurtleBot3 mobile base
intro: ROBOTIS TurtleBot3 mobile base, adapted from robotis-git/turtlebot3. It reads `battery_voltage`, `battery_percentage`, `battery_present`, `odom_pose` and 3 more; runs `publish_velocity`, `set_motor_power` and `disable_torque`. `publish_velocity`: publish one geometry_msgs/TwistStamped velocity setpoint to the upstream cmd_vel topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
